name: Netlify
description: Netlify is a unified platform to "create with AI or code, deploy instantly on production infrastructure," supporting deploys via Git, CLI, drag-and-drop, or AI agents.
best_for: Positioned for diverse teams — product engineers, AI developers, marketers, designers, and ops personnel — building AI-powered apps, marketing sites, e-commerce storefronts, fullstack apps, and internal tools.
features: Multiple deploy paths: Git, CLI, drag-and-drop, AI Agent Runners
AI Gateway for model access (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini)
Global edge network (100+ locations) with 99.99% uptime SLA
